characters.name: Tove
characters.greeting: We sleep together so we dream together. Don't touch anything.

request.text: Jorun doesn't sleep. Bo keeps something bitter in a jar, down in his dream. Go and get it; the wall knows the way.

lines.text: It's lit. From the inside, like I said. Every door down there has a name on it now; don't read them all at once.
You were in my head last night. Wipe your feet. And put that lantern on the desk before the light goes.
Bo's dream. Choose it on the wall, go down, and don't come up without the jar.
Jorun slept through. Whatever is in that jar, keep it by the bunk and don't tell me.
One more window lit. One fewer bunk to bank the stove for. Jorun snores, you know. Did you know?

characters.name: Jorun
characters.greeting: You're going to sleep to help me. Bold. I've been doing that for years and the ice never once fixed itself.

lines.text: Sixteen steps, all of them. Jorun has seen the scaffold. Jorun does not look pleased. Jorun is pleased.
You were in my head last night. Wipe your feet. If you saw the stairs, you saw them right: sixteen, not fifteen.
I counted them twice. I live at the top now, and the fish live at the bottom, and nobody needs the ladder. Don't touch the railing.
Fourth time. I am not a stair. I am not a ladder either. Go to sleep and stay there.
Three times now. Tove has started a column for it. I told her to use a bigger wall.
Twice. You woke up shouting twice. The stove heard you. The stove hears everything.
You woke up shouting. Once. Everyone does once. Do it again and I start counting.

characters.name: Bo
characters.greeting: Bo. Hats, mostly. Don't ask about the needle, I'm not ready to talk about the needle.

lines.text: You brought the jar up whole. One of those and Jorun will sleep through the thaw. Don't tell her what's in them. I don't know either.
You were in my head last night. Wipe your feet. Did you touch the jar? Don't answer. Put it on the desk.
